olga: Deploying a CF Worker that imports our JS SDK fails with "require is not defined" and missing Buffer. Bundle pulled in fs/net. Any lightweight fix?

tariq: Two pragmatic patterns: 1) add an explicit edge entrypoint (e.g. `@redwood/inference-js/edge`) that only uses web APIs; or 2) keep single package but guard node-only imports with runtime checks + dynamic import so bundlers don't include them.

sam: For exports layout try: `exports:{".":{"default":"./dist/index.mjs","node":"./dist/index.node.cjs"},"./edge":{"default":"./dist/index.edge.mjs"}}` then consumers can `import '.../edge'`.

olga: How do we handle base64/hmac on edge without Buffer/crypto?

tariq: Use `atob`/`btoa` + TextEncoder/Decoder for base64. For HMAC use Web Crypto `crypto.subtle.importKey`/`sign`. For any Buffer-like API surface, provide a tiny internal shim implementing only needed helpers.

sam: Types: set top-level `types: ./dist/index.d.ts` that is runtime-agnostic. If you ship an `/edge` entrypoint, add `index.edge.d.ts` but keep main `types` for most users.

edge-ci-bot: build error feature/worker-fix: "Could not resolve \"fs\" from dist/index.node.cjs" at 2026-04-01T09:12:03Z

olga: Action items: sam - PR for edge entrypoint + exports, tariq - add dynamic-import guards and small base64 shim, sam - add CI job to esbuild bundle the edge entry to catch regressions. I'll test `import '@redwood/inference-js/edge'` as a temporary workaround. :thumbsup:
